The authored-rest fixture waits for observable movement instead of assuming two frames. The drawer fixture no longer projects a hidden hub drawer on the protagonist title screen.

Final assertion cleanup removed one opening-copy/default snapshot test and a hard-coded fallback-copy expectation without changing game code or authored copy. All three opening safety/precedence cases passed in the final 56-case EditMode run. The earlier 57-case receipt is preserved as editmode-before-assertion-cleanup.xml.

Focused corrections then passed 100 PlayMode + 56 EditMode + 1 isolated serialized-boot case. The real profile recreation smoke passed, its temporary source was removed before the final EditMode/boot/build, and protected record-name fallback invariants were strengthened.

A later event-ordering advisory was checked with real InputSystem events. Three existing cases passed again after adding explicit no-rebuild/no-gameplay assertions for Enter/Escape/controller cancel. Runtime sources and native assembly are unchanged; the full-suite XML predates only these assertion additions.

The prior ordinary-focus restoration invariant was then checked explicitly with real Enter input in one existing PlayMode case (1/1). Its new XML is supplemental; the 157 unique total and native-build scope are unchanged.
